verdict.rationale: The only self-hosting signal is the W&B release policy, which covers 'W&B Server (Dedicated Cloud/Self-Managed)', plus server release notes that include Weave features. Together these imply a Self-Managed W&B Server deployment that carries Weave. That is a single thin mention, not a documented self-host path for Weave. missing for 10: explicit docs that Weave runs on Self-Managed deployments, installation/deployment instructions (e.g. Docker/Helm), self-hosted configuration and requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted Weave instance.
